arrival.noDeadlineArrived: No deadline; the goods arrived on {date}

check.noPolicy: No live return policy for this customer: the sales settings apply
check.outside_one: {count} line is outside its return window
check.outside_other: {count} lines are outside their return window
check.noWithdrawal: The consumer's right of withdrawal does not apply to this return

credit.title: Credit without return
credit.sub: A credit for goods the customer keeps (nothing of the line came back), within the approval limit.
credit.waitsInbox: Waits for a yes in Home › Approvals
credit.limit: Within the approval limit the credit is written at once; above it, it waits for a yes from someone else. Nobody approves their own request.
credit.done: Line {seq} is credited without the goods coming back.
credit.asked: The credit of line {seq} waits for a yes (Home › Approvals).

dialog.title: Credit line {seq} without the goods
dialog.body: The customer keeps the goods: nothing of this line has come back. The credit note is made in Finance afterwards.
dialog.amountHint: Empty: what its pieces are worth ({value}). Less is a partial credit.
dialog.noteHint: Kept with the request and on the record's history.
dialog.needsYes: Above your approval limit: this asks for a yes.
dialog.atOnce: Within your approval limit: it is credited at once.
dialog.effect: The line then expects no goods; the return can be closed as credited without the goods.

problem.over: More than the line is worth.
problem.state: The return is not in a state to credit without the goods.
problem.line: This line cannot be credited without the goods now.
problem.other: The credit cannot be asked like this.
problem.nobodyElse: Nobody else can approve this credit: ask your administrator.

estimate.title: Estimate {revision}
estimate.sub: Parts and labour, approved by the customer before the work starts.
estimate.noPrices: An estimate is prices: your role doesn't see prices, so it is drawn without them and can't be changed.
estimate.emptyBody: Make the estimate: the parts and the work, with their prices, for the customer to approve before the repair starts.
estimate.editHint: Enter edits a cell; each change is saved on its own.
estimate.historySub: Every revision is kept: what was sent and what the customer answered.

ACCEPTED.PORTAL: Accepted by the customer in the portal ({name})
ACCEPTED.LINK: Accepted by the customer through a link ({name})
ACCEPTED.OFFICE: Accepted by the customer, recorded by the office ({name})

DECLINED.PORTAL: Declined by the customer in the portal ({name})
DECLINED.LINK: Declined by the customer through a link ({name})
DECLINED.OFFICE: Declined by the customer, recorded by the office ({name})

work.waiting: Approval and the repair wait for the customer's answer to estimate {revision}.
work.declined: The customer declined estimate {revision}: make a new revision, or cancel or send back the repair.
work.held: The estimate holds the approval and the repair.

held.prices: Estimates are prices: your role doesn't see prices.

edit.SENT: The estimate is sent: what the customer sees no longer changes (make a new revision).
edit.ACCEPTED: The customer accepted the estimate: it no longer changes.
edit.DECLINED: The customer declined the estimate: make a new revision.

held.stage: Not possible at this stage of the repair.
held.noLines: Add a part or labour first.
held.garmentFirst: Receive the garment first: the estimate is sent once it is here.
held.expired: The estimate's last valid day is past: change it in Edit terms.
held.notSent: Only a sent estimate gets an answer.
held.notNewest: Only the newest revision may be revised.
held.draftOpen: Estimate {revision} is still a draft: finish it or withdraw it.

problem.description: Say what the part or the job is, in one line the customer reads.
problem.unitPrice: A price of 0 or more, like 12.50.
problem.minutes: Whole minutes of work, 1 or more (labour only).
problem.unitCost: A cost of 0 or more, like 4.20, or empty.

newDialog.title: Make estimate {revision}
newDialog.first: A new draft estimate, empty: add its parts and labour.
newDialog.copies_one: A new draft that starts from estimate {revision} with its {count} line.
newDialog.copies_other: A new draft that starts from estimate {revision} with its {count} lines.
newDialog.replaces: Estimate {revision} was sent: the new revision withdraws it, and the customer sees the new one once it is sent.

send.title: Send estimate {revision} of {number}
send.portal: The customer sees it in their portal and accepts or declines it there.
send.frozen: After sending, its lines and terms no longer change: a change is a new revision.
send.noMail: Nothing is mailed: a customer without the portal answers by phone or mail, and the office records the answer.

answer.title: The customer's answer to estimate {revision}
answer.body: What the customer said, as the office heard it. An accepted estimate approves the repair.
answer.label: The answer
answer.acceptedHint: The repair is approved: the work can start.
answer.howHint: For example: by phone, by mail of today.
answer.name: Who answered

problem.how: Say how the office heard the answer.
problem.reason: Write the customer's reason for declining.

withdraw.title: Withdraw estimate {revision}
withdraw.body: The draft is withdrawn: it stays in the revisions.
withdraw.bodySent: The sent estimate is withdrawn: the customer can no longer answer it.

terms.title: Terms of estimate {revision}
terms.sentOnly: Sent: only the internal note changes.
terms.customerHint: Shown to the customer with the estimate.

problem.past: The last valid day can't be in the past.

done.sent: Estimate {revision} is sent: the customer sees it in the portal.
done.accepted: Estimate {revision} accepted: the repair is approved.

exchange.noSizes: No other size of this style
exchange.pickSize: Line {seq}: pick the size the customer gets instead.

fee.title: Restocking or handling fee
fee.sub: Withheld from the credit by the policy's fee rules; dropped when the cause is ours.
fee.noPolicy: This return follows the sales settings: no fee rule applies.
fee.noRule: No fee rule applies to this line.
fee.atDecision: Set when the line is decided.

dropped.OUR_CAUSE: Fee {rule} dropped: the cause is ours
dropped.NO_CREDIT: Fee {rule} dropped: no credit to take it from
dropped.OTHER_CURRENCY: Fee {rule} dropped: the credit is in another currency

finish.COMPLETED: Completed: every line decided and done
finish.CREDITED_WITHOUT_RETURN: Credited without the goods coming back
finish.RETURNED_UNCHANGED: Sent back to the customer as it came
finish.CUSTOMER_WITHDREW: The customer no longer wants the return

held.CREDITED_WITHOUT_RETURN: No line was credited without the goods.
held.RETURNED_UNCHANGED: No line goes back to the customer as it came.
held.GOODS_NOT_RECEIVED: Every piece expected arrived (or was credited without the goods).
held.CUSTOMER_WITHDREW: A credit was given: the return was carried out, not withdrawn.

credit.done: Line {seq} is credited without the goods already.
credit.waiting: The credit of line {seq} waits for a yes.
credit.arrived: Goods of line {seq} arrived: decide it instead.
credit.noPrice: The line's value is not known: it was not sold at a price.

papers.code: The scan code is set by someone who manages returns.
papers.state: No papers for a return in this state.

policy.state: The policy is bound once the return is authorised, before the goods arrive.

split.beforeGoods: Line {seq}: split once the goods arrive.
split.credited: Line {seq} is credited without the goods.

late.tileHint: Open returns whose goods came after their deadline
late.failed: Couldn't read which returns arrived after the deadline.

policy.notBound: No return policy is bound yet: {name} is live. Bind it to set the deadline and the fees.
policy.done: The policy is bound: the goods are due by {date}.

dialog.body: The live policy of the customer's channel: its deadline counts from the authorisation, and its fee rules apply to the credits.
dialog.withdrawal: The consumer withdraws from the purchase (14 days, no reason needed)
dialog.reason: Why accept it outside the window
dialog.reasonHint: A courtesy: kept on the record's history.

problem.none: No live return policy for this channel (Sales › Settings).
problem.reason: A line is outside its window: say why it is accepted.
problem.state: The policy is bound only on an authorised return.

remake.title: A remake was asked ({via}, {date})
remake.later: The remake is decided by the made-to-measure office (later); for now, receive the garment.
remake.decideLater: The remake is decided by the made-to-measure office (later).

scanCode.none: Not set yet (set when the papers are printed)
